name: Niemoruk
backstory: Child of Fenriukas and Niemornak in Salthos Cruzados; raised alongside walks the transit route's Salthos stretch at dawn..., having heard about Death Of Niemius.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Heard that Fenserika and Niekus now have a child, Fenekus.

criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only by paying real attention to Salthos Cruzados
criterion.wasted_life: letting Salthos Cruzados slip past unexamined, the way it's easiest to
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: walks the crossing at dawn and dusk same as always, but stops fewer travelers now that he knows most of them by face

arc.premise: Niemoruk thinks half the shortfall traces to tolls collected in the open with no proper booth or ledger stand at hand - he wants the house to actually build one at the crossing instead of guards working out of a pouch and memory.
